name: homeflow
description: Pranava HomeFlow — post-sales OS for residential real estate. Monorepo: apps/ (frontend), services/ (backend), infra/ (AWS CDK), docs/spec (build contract).

scripts.test: npm --prefix services/api test && npm --prefix apps/workspace test
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix services/api run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/workspace run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/my-pranava-home run typecheck
